promotion_escape.speaker: Scrip
promotion_escape.line: This defeat is being appealed through a smaller, faster door.

promotion_escape.speaker: Scrip
promotion_escape.line: You have not killed me. You have created an unresolved staffing concern.

promotion_escape.speaker: Scrip
promotion_escape.line: I am withdrawing until your weapons receive less persuasive representation.

promotion_escape.speaker: Scrip
promotion_escape.line: The complaint hatch is not an escape route. It is an alternate chain of command.

promotion_escape.speaker: Scrip
promotion_escape.line: Keep the office. The office knows what it did.

promotion_escape.speaker: Scrip
promotion_escape.line: My survival has been pre-approved by me.

return_opening.speaker: Scrip
return_opening.line: I remember {member}, the {action}, and the regrettably educational {damage_type}.

return_opening.speaker: Scrip
return_opening.line: Welcome back to {room}. I reinforced the complaint hatch and several personal opinions.

return_opening.speaker: Scrip
return_opening.line: Expedition {run} was not a defeat. It was an involuntary performance review with weapons.

return_opening.speaker: Scrip
return_opening.line: You used {damage_type} in {room}. I have since become professionally conductive about it.

return_opening.speaker: Scrip
return_opening.line: I recognize that formation. It ends with {member} doing something administratively final.

return_opening.speaker: Scrip
return_opening.line: The record says {action}. My scar says the record is underselling it.

return_opening.speaker: Scrip
return_opening.line: I was promised a stronger staff. They sent a replacement and called that morale.

return_opening.speaker: Scrip
return_opening.line: Before we begin, the ceiling is humming and my new supervisor is pretending not to hear it.

return_opening.speaker: Scrip
return_opening.line: I have returned slightly stronger and substantially more specific.

return_opening.speaker: Scrip
return_opening.line: No one leaves this office until someone explains why the furniture is armed.

return_opening.speaker: Scrip
return_opening.line: You broke my seal, my desk, and a very promising sense of superiority.

return_opening.speaker: Scrip
return_opening.line: I prepared a speech. Then the replacement staff wired the speech to the mains.

cite_record_party.speaker: Ilex
cite_record_party.line: Your own record says another fight has the survival value of decorative poison.

cite_record_party.speaker: Moss
cite_record_party.line: We know which memory hurts. We can cite it by paragraph if necessary.

cite_record_party.speaker: Dena
cite_record_party.line: You survived because you left. That remains the best idea you have had.

cite_record_party.speaker: Vell
cite_record_party.line: I checked the pipes. Your escape route is still winning the argument.

cite_record_success.speaker: Scrip
cite_record_success.line: The evidence is hostile, but unfortunately admissible.

cite_record_success.speaker: Scrip
cite_record_success.line: I withdraw under protest and several medically relevant memories.

cite_record_success.speaker: Scrip
cite_record_success.line: Fine. The office is yours until it develops better representation.

cite_record_success.speaker: Scrip
cite_record_success.line: My fear is not agreement. It is a highly qualified scheduling decision.

cite_record_success.speaker: Scrip
cite_record_success.line: I concede the room, not the argument, the desk, or the good stapler.

cite_record_success.speaker: Scrip
cite_record_success.line: This encounter has been canceled for compelling historical reasons.

partnership_party.speaker: Vell
partnership_party.line: Your replacement supervisor plans to ground the overload through you. We offer a less fatal circuit.

partnership_party.speaker: Ilex
partnership_party.line: The room will discharge. Help us stop it and everyone keeps the organs they arrived with.

partnership_party.speaker: Moss
partnership_party.line: Your greed is pretending to be loyalty. We can pay it in continued existence.

partnership_party.speaker: Dena
partnership_party.line: Choose quickly. The ceiling has begun making command decisions.

partnership_success.speaker: Scrip
partnership_success.line: Temporary cooperation. Permanent survival. I accept the ratio.

partnership_success.speaker: Scrip
partnership_success.line: I have always opposed my supervisor in the private theater of my mind.

partnership_success.speaker: Scrip
partnership_success.line: Point me at the payroll authority and look surprised when I defect.

partnership_success.speaker: Scrip
partnership_success.line: This is not friendship. It is a merger where nobody reads the liability section.

partnership_success.speaker: Scrip
partnership_success.line: I will ground the first surge. You handle everyone who objects professionally.

partnership_success.speaker: Scrip
partnership_success.line: My loyalty has encountered a more competitive offer from self-preservation.

partnership_failure.speaker: Scrip
partnership_failure.line: Tempting, but my terror has selected the familiar employer.

partnership_failure.speaker: Scrip
partnership_failure.line: I decline. The replacement staff knows where I keep my unapproved lunch.

partnership_failure.speaker: Scrip
partnership_failure.line: Your offer lacks a dental plan and at least one credible exit.

partnership_failure.speaker: Scrip
partnership_failure.line: I prefer predictable mistreatment to entrepreneurial danger.

taunt_party.speaker: Dena
taunt_party.line: Did the new title come with armor, or only a longer place to write coward?

taunt_party.speaker: Moss
taunt_party.line: I kept a culture from your old fear. It has become articulate.

taunt_party.speaker: Vell
taunt_party.line: Nice reinforcement. Is it load-bearing, or does it resign when struck?

taunt_party.speaker: Ilex
taunt_party.line: Your pulse is already filing a request to leave.

taunt_success.speaker: Scrip
taunt_success.line: I will staple that confidence to something load-bearing.

taunt_success.speaker: Scrip
taunt_success.line: I rehearsed restraint and have misplaced every page.

taunt_success.speaker: Scrip
taunt_success.line: You wanted initiative. Take it before I regain professional judgment.

taunt_success.speaker: Scrip
taunt_success.line: My anger has waived the usual opening procedures.

taunt_success.speaker: Scrip
taunt_success.line: Fine. We settle this through the ancient appeals process of hitting.

leave_parley.speaker: Dena
leave_parley.line: Discussion closed. Keep your hands where the intentions panel can see them.

leave_parley.speaker: Scrip
leave_parley.line: At last, a traditional meeting with measurable injuries.

leave_parley.speaker: Picket
leave_parley.line: Parley ended voluntarily. The critical route remains embarrassingly available.

leave_parley.speaker: Scrip
leave_parley.line: No check, no trick, no timer. Just the regrettable clarity of combat.

ally_assist.speaker: Scrip
ally_assist.line: I grounded the first surge through payroll. Payroll has noticed.

ally_assist.speaker: Scrip
ally_assist.line: Opening Guard applied. I deny understanding the heroic implications.

ally_assist.speaker: Scrip
ally_assist.line: The replacement staff is softened. Please finish the restructuring.

ally_assist.speaker: Scrip
ally_assist.line: I have damaged my coworkers in a strictly temporary capacity.

ally_assist.speaker: Vell
ally_assist.line: The circuit held. I hate how employable that makes you.

ally_assist.speaker: Moss
ally_assist.line: Cooperation suits you. Like a borrowed coat with suspicious pockets.

bar_opening_rival.speaker: Scrip
bar_opening_rival.line: Neutral ground. My grievance has checked its weapons and kept its vocabulary.

bar_opening_rival.speaker: Scrip
bar_opening_rival.line: The Bent Pipe serves three drinks and seventeen interpretations of not fighting.

bar_opening_rival.speaker: Scrip
bar_opening_rival.line: Sit if you must. The stool has fewer loyalties than either of us.

bar_opening_rival.speaker: Scrip
bar_opening_rival.line: I am off duty, which means the paperwork is merely emotional.

bar_opening_ally.speaker: Scrip
bar_opening_ally.line: I saved you a seat. It is not friendship; the chair was threatening witnesses.

bar_opening_ally.speaker: Scrip
bar_opening_ally.line: We survived together. The bar insists this creates a shared tab.

bar_opening_ally.speaker: Scrip
bar_opening_ally.line: My former supervisor has described me as missing equipment. I feel promoted.

bar_opening_ally.speaker: Scrip
bar_opening_ally.line: Temporary alliance debrief. Drinks are permanent until metabolized.

bar_opening_friend.speaker: Scrip
bar_opening_friend.line: There you are. I saved the good booth and several bad decisions.

bar_opening_friend.speaker: Scrip
bar_opening_friend.line: Friend is an aggressive word. Reliable co-survivor with beverage access is accurate.

bar_opening_friend.speaker: Scrip
bar_opening_friend.line: I told the bartender you broke my office. She added a structural surcharge.

bar_opening_friend.speaker: Scrip
bar_opening_friend.line: The old defeat still hurts. The new company is an acceptable complication.

share_booth.speaker: Ilex
share_booth.line: You stood with us when the room turned lethal. Sit with us while it is merely sticky.

share_booth.speaker: Scrip
share_booth.line: A second voluntary association. This is becoming statistically sincere.

share_booth.speaker: Dena
share_booth.line: No contracts. No ownership. Show up when you say you will.

share_booth.speaker: Scrip
share_booth.line: Then I accept friendship under the terrifying doctrine of plain meaning.

share_booth.speaker: Moss
share_booth.line: Welcome. We insult each other because the alternative is emotional paperwork.

share_booth.speaker: Scrip
share_booth.line: I have never felt less regulated. It is appalling and somewhat nice.

paid_neutrality.speaker: Vell
paid_neutrality.line: We offer profitable neutrality, paid in route information and not hitting you.

paid_neutrality.speaker: Scrip
paid_neutrality.line: Not being hit has matured into one of my strongest markets.

paid_neutrality.speaker: Scrip
paid_neutrality.line: Neutrality accepted. My grievance remains on retainer but off the schedule.

paid_neutrality.speaker: Picket
paid_neutrality.line: Paid neutrality recorded. No owned item was surrendered or quietly reclassified.

buy_information.speaker: Vell
buy_information.line: Tell us which valve the replacement staff is afraid to label.

buy_information.speaker: Scrip
buy_information.line: Second blue wheel past the cistern. Turn it until management becomes audible.

buy_information.speaker: Picket
buy_information.line: Valve route learned. The next expedition begins with the pressure option revealed, not mandatory.

buy_information.speaker: Scrip
buy_information.line: Payment is one future drink and continued discretion about my competence.

trade_insults.speaker: Moss
trade_insults.line: You look like a rejected form learned to resent handwriting.

trade_insults.speaker: Scrip
trade_insults.line: You smell like a basement won custody of a witch.

trade_insults.speaker: Scrip
trade_insults.line: Respect increased against my better administrative judgment.

bar_leave.speaker: Scrip
bar_leave.line: Leave, then. The neutral stool will miss your tactical posture.

bar_leave.speaker: Picket
bar_leave.line: Bar visit concluded without violence, theft, timers, or mandatory emotional progress.

bar_leave.speaker: Scrip
bar_leave.line: Our relationship remains complicated and therefore properly documented.

bar_leave.speaker: Marda
bar_leave.line: Come back when someone has a better story or worse judgment.
